text:
Aisha: Morning — quick heads up: around 03:17 UTC the eu-west inference pool had a short memory burst after automatic KV-warmup change; several requests returned 503 for ~2m. Alerts fired. I rolled back the warmup flag and scaled the pool up +2 to absorb load. Collecting logs now.
Ben: saw it too, caught the alert. do you have the alert id? can we reduce page noise? :sweat_smile:
Aisha: Alert id: eu_mem_burst_2026_03_18
Aisha: quick logs snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:17:12Z kernel: oom-killer invoked, mem_used=86% -> 95%
service/inference: HTTP 503 x 120s, kv-warmup: start padding=128 -> 512
```
Carlos: hmm that padding jump matches the PR we merged last night (runtime/kv: auto-pad heuristic). @Ben the alert is current prometheus rule `instance_memory_burst` — it fires on 1m. Suggest change to `for: 2m` to avoid transient warmups.
Ben: agree. Also add a label so devs don't get paged for warmup-only incidents (severity=info -> pager=false). I'll draft a PR.
runbook-bot: Runbook check: `kv-warmup` section missing a recovery step for manual rollback. Opening issue #452.
oncall-bot: Paging history: pager sent to @Lee at 03:18, acknowledged 03:19.
Lee: ack. what I did: scaled +2, reverted runtime flag. blockers: need a safe canary window to re-roll the padding change. today: prep canary+metrics dashboard.
Aisha: Proposed action items:
- Ben: PR to adjust alert `for: 2m` and add label `warmup=true`
- Carlos: add explicit warmup detection metric (kv.warmup_active)
- Lee: schedule a 30-min canary in eu-west tomorrow 01:00-01:30 UTC
- Runbook: add manual rollback steps and pager exemptions
Ben: will open PR in 30m and ping for review. small diff:
```
- alert: instance_memory_burst
  expr: increase(node_memory_bytes_used[1m]) > 0.2
+ alert: instance_memory_burst
  for: 2m
  labels:
    warmup: "true"
```
Carlos: I'll instrument kv.warmup_active as a gauge today and wire into dashboard.
Aisha: final note — if the canary is green we should reapply the padding change with a lower step (256) and monitored ramp. :white_check_mark:
Lee: copying action items to handoff doc and will notify oncall before canary.
Ben: ping me for review, I'll prioritize after standup. :thumbsup:
Aisha: thanks all — will update thread with logs and PR links when available.
